description: Adszy provides read-only PPC analysis of accounts connected through Adszy, including account health, budget pacing, wasted spend, disapprovals, anomalies, auction insights, and period comparisons. It works with Google Ads accounts and cannot create or change campaigns. Adszy is independently developed and is not endorsed or operated by Google.

defaultPrompt: What needs attention in my Google Ads account today?
Find wasted spend and explain the evidence.
Compare this period with the previous one and draft a client-ready brief.
